# Workbench

> Workbench is a free, browser-based low-poly 3D modeling, texturing, animation, and MultiCraft/Luanti creation studio. Build, paint, rig, and export 3D models alongside integrated game asset and WorldEdit utilities directly in the browser.

## Core Studio

- [Workbench Web Studio](https://workbench.bond/): Interactive WebGL low-poly 3D modeling, UV texturing, pixel painting, and keyframe animation editor.
- [Workbench Wiki](https://about.workbench.bond/wiki): Official documentation, guides, and tutorials for Workbench.
- [Full Documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://workbench.bond/llms-full.txt): Complete reference covering all modeling formats, editor modes, export codecs, and built-in Workbench tools.
- [Sitemap](https://workbench.bond/sitemap.xml): XML index of public Workbench pages and integrated tools.

## 3D Modeling & Formats

- **MultiCraft Character & Generic Models**: Create low-poly 3D meshes, character rigs, props, and voxel geometry with per-face UV mapping and bone hierarchies.
- **Blitz3D (`.b3d`) Support**: Built-in support for importing and opening `.b3d` models directly into Generic Model projects.
- **Voxel & Game Formats**: Support for `.bbmodel`, Minecraft Java Block/Item JSON, Bedrock Entity/Block geometry, Wavefront `.obj`, `.gltf`/`.glb`, `.fbx`, and `.dae`.
- **Editor Modes**: Edit (modeling & UV), Paint (3D mesh & 2D texture pixel painting), Animate (bone keyframe timeline), and Display (item/camera previews).

## Integrated Workbench Tools

- [Luanti Skin Studio](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/luanti-skin-studio/index.html): Design, customize, and export HD 128x64 character skins for MultiCraft and Luanti with real-time 3D preview, color palettes, and layers.
- [Multicraft Seed Viewer](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/mtc-seed-viewer/index.html): Explore and visualize MultiCraft mapgen v7 seeds, biomes, and terrain elevations with interactive 2D coordinates.
- [Luanti Brush Studio](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/brush_metadata_editor/dist/index.html): Minetest and Luanti WorldEdit/Terraform brush command generator with live isometric voxel preview.
- [MultiCraft Metadata Editor](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/metadata/dist/index.html): Build item metadata, tool capabilities, custom color formatting, lore, and enchantments with instant command export.
- [Microcontroller Emulator](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/microcontroller-emulator/dist/index.html): Mesecons microcontroller logic sandbox and emulator with A-D pins, 256-byte EEPROM, step debugger, and scripting.
- [Name Tag Asset Catalog](https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/nametag/index.html): Searchable MultiCraft & Minetest technical ID catalog for blocks, items, tools, food, and mobs.

- [MultiCraft Build Tiers Discord](https://discord.gg/h3kwTkmHZw): Official community partner showcasing popular builders and well-known building creators in MultiCraft.
